maker: Shenzhen Legend Robot Technology Co., Ltd.
name: Legend Robot LQ07A latex paint spraying robot (6.2 m)
summary: Wheeled interior robot with telescopic outriggers, a lifting mast and a six-axis arm that sprays latex paint airless onto walls, ceilings and beams up to 6.2 m. Paint-only high-wall model; one operator supervises up to three robots.

germany.statusNote: No German or EU seller found; enquiries go to the maker in Shenzhen (quote form, e-mail, WhatsApp). Legend Robot says it previewed its latex paint and putty spraying robot at BATIMAT 2026 in Paris with its "European partner ROBOSWISS AG" and that the system is engineered to EU CE standards, but the article does not name the model and no European sales page or price was found.
